task_details.task_introduction: Help us build a video dataset by submitting short point of view (POV) videos of you completing a task. Each recording clip should be between 10 and 20 seconds long. Keep your hands clearly visible within the frame at all times while recording — if your hands leave the frame, the clip may not be usable. Please don't rush: complete the activity at your normal pace and to your usual standard, exactly as you would if no one were filming.
task_details.task_steps:
1. Review the consent information
  2. Answer questions about yourself
  3. Decide which activity you will record
  4. Record the activity naturally and without rushing, keeping your hands clearly visible in frame throughout
  5. Upload a clear POV video recorded using smart glasses, a Go Pro type device, or body-mounted smart phone
